title: Connect your email
blurb: Send from your own domain and sync your Gmail or Outlook inbox.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Everything to do with email lives in **Settings**, at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Email Services
steps.body: Click **Email Services**. This is where Luubu sends your emails from.

steps.title: Send from your own domain
steps.body: Your account can already send email. For the best delivery, send from your own domain: click **Dedicated Domain And IP**, enter a subdomain like **mail.yourbusiness.co.nz**, then add the records it shows you at your domain provider.
steps.tip: Not sure where your domain is managed? Common ones are Crazy Domains, GoDaddy, Cloudflare and 1st Domains.
steps.awayText: Next we'll set up your sending domain in Email Services.

steps.title: Now sync your inbox
steps.body: To see and reply to your emails inside Luubu, connect your Gmail or Outlook. Click **Integrations** in the left menu.

steps.title: Connect Google or Microsoft
steps.body: On the **Google** card (for Gmail) or the **Outlook** card, click **Connect**. Sign in with your business email and allow access when asked.
steps.tip: Once connected, new emails show up in **Conversations** alongside your texts and messages.
